history.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one standalone realistic Yuan northern-China map sprite. Original game reconstruction, not exact monument. Photoreal hand-made grey tile, buff earthen plaster, brown timber, stone; same restrained realistic detail density as Song map kit, no toy look. CRITICAL orthographic2:1 dimetric camera yaw45 pitch30; ground axes slopes+0.5/-0.5 precisely, all parallel edges remain parallel, verticals vertical, no perspective. Thin FLAT rectangular ground apron, visible LEFT/FRONT/RIGHT ground corners; no thick slab. Transparent RGBA background, whole object with 10% transparent margin, upper-left light and very short lower-right contact shadow. No text, lettering, people, animals, signs, flags, UI, watermark, modern objects, sky, scenery, checkerboard, Qing architecture, elaborate gold dragons. Subject: northern Yuan prosperous private MANOR18x14m rectangle. A restrained enclosed two-court household: main wide gray gable-roof house, smaller low wing rooms, front cart gate integrated into thick buff earthen wall, a second interior cross-wall, limited bare earth and flagstone courts, two storage jars, ONE small elm within enclosure only. No pond, pavilion, rock garden, southern white walls, ornate carved screens. Reference material and detail density only, independent design. Ground width-depth ratio18:14; entire floor footprint has simple FOUR corners, flat thin rectangular apron. All base edge angles26.565degrees from horizontal, front edge slope+0.5 right edge-0.5, camera low30degrees. Low-pitched broad roof planes with simple rolled tile ridges.
